name: AI UI Style Vault 3D Asset Quality Gate
principle: A technically valid GLB/GLTF is not automatically a production-quality 3D product asset. Geometry, visual fidelity, source coverage, material response, proportions, browser integrity and fallback behavior must all be evaluated before handoff.

modePolicy.interactive-world: publish-required-for-verified-real-assets; prototype allowed only when clearly conceptual

referenceCoverage.alternative: Owner-approved construction/CAD/scan/pattern source may substitute for missing photographic angles when recorded explicitly.
referenceCoverage.rule: If unseen geometry is materially invented, the asset must remain labelled as a concept/prototype rather than an exact product representation.

technicalGuidance.rule: Triangle/vertex counts are diagnostics and performance inputs, not proof of visual quality. A dense primitive proxy can still fail; a well-authored efficient mesh can pass.

handoffRule: For inspectable/configurable real products, block production handoff when the asset is merely a placeholder, blocky proxy or materially invented 360 view. Preserve the selected 3D mode, route back to asset production, and keep source photographs available until a publish-grade asset passes.
